title: CardioLoom: A Report-Guided Electrocardiogram Foundation Model for Cross-Domain Cardiovascular Phenotyping
abstract: arXiv:2605.25446v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Routine electrocardiogram (ECG) reports offer scalable supervision for cardiovascular representation learning. In this retrospective study, we pretrained CardioLoom, a report-guided ECG foundation model, on 2,781,289 ECG-report pairs from 1,298,359 patients. Downstream development used a separate cohort of 721,317 ECGs from 233,798 patients. Evaluation covered 89 targets, with external testing in nine cohorts. Across 45 internal ECG diagnoses, macro area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) was 0.624 versus 0.615 for DeepECG-SSL. Across 203 external ECG evaluations, corresponding means were 0.425 and 0.424. Using labels from 10% of training patients, CardioLoom achieved macro-AUPRC 0.559, exceeding supervised training with all labels (0.549). translated_title: CardioLoom：一种用于跨领域心血管表型分析的报告引导式心电图基础模型
translated_abstract: 常规心电图（ECG）报告为心血管表征学习提供了可扩展的监督信号。在这项回顾性研究中，我们在来自1,298,359名患者的2,781,289个心电图-报告配对数据上预训练了CardioLoom——一种报告引导的心电图基础模型。下游开发使用了来自233,798名患者的721,317份心电图的独立队列。评估涵盖89个目标，并在九个队列中进行了外部测试。在45项内部心电图诊断中，宏平均精确率-召回率曲线下面积（AUPRC）为0.624，而DeepECG-SSL为0.615。在203项外部心电图评估中，相应均值分别为0.425和0.424。仅使用10%训练患者的标签，CardioLoom的宏平均AUPRC即达到0.559，超过了使用全部标签的监督训练（0.549）。对于射血分数降低的心力衰竭，在中山、世源和BIDMC三个队列中的AUPRC分别为0.690、0.641和0.677。在心脏淀粉样变性筛查中获得了4.5%的阳性预测值。
tldr: CardioLoom是一种利用近280万心电图-报告配对数据预训练的报告引导式心电图基础模型，在89个内外部心血管表型评估目标上表现优异，仅用10%标注数据即可超越全量监督训练的性能，实现了跨领域的疾病诊断与筛查能力。
en_tdlr: CardioLoom is a report-guided ECG foundation model pretrained on 2.78 million ECG-report pairs, achieving strong cross-domain cardiovascular phenotyping across 89 targets and nine external cohorts, and even outperforming fully supervised training using only 10% of the labels.
